integrity: The analytic proof determines the all-data criterion; exact-rational certificates check two explicit failure witnesses and finite sample cases only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes positive vertex masses, positive cyclic edge penalties, strictly convex diagonal quadratic fidelity, and a common TV scalar on a simple finite cycle. Historical equivalents may be unindexed; no external or independent audit is claimed.
title: Irreversible edge fusion on weighted cycles: a four-vertex rigidity theorem and a triangle exception
